content: {"praised":["Vivid portrait of rural English village life.","Realistic depiction of working‑class struggles during WWI.","Strong, bleak tone reflecting early twentieth‑century hardships.","Cinematography captures rugged, mossy landscape beautifully.","Essential viewing for fans of Downton Abbey’s realism."],"criticized":["Story lacks coherent structure and pacing.","Characters portrayed as one‑dimensional, cruel, and selfish.","Depicts village life as brutally harsh and primitive.","Gratuitous shocking scenes feel forced and unnecessary.","No effort to show characters as good and bad."]}
